E1265

`core.crypto.vault.get` can't be reached from a build-time context.

What

`core.crypto.vault.get` can't be reached from a build-time context.

Why

Module-field and comptime evaluation run before secrets are decrypted (D-JPK-SECRETCRYPTO1). A repository opens its encrypted store only at ordinary runtime, such as inside a `-[Secret]>` function. There is no audited gate escape because a build artifact must never contain a decrypted secret.

Fix

Move the secret read out of comptime or module-field evaluation and into ordinary runtime code.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E1265: tests/ui/secret_in_build.stderr.

Error [E1265]: `core.crypto.vault.get()` can't be reached from a build-time context
  --> tests/ui/secret_in_build.jet:4:19
    |
  4 |     @cfg :: vault.get("db_password")
    |                   ^^^
 Why: module-field/comptime evaluation runs before secrets are ever decrypted; a repo's encrypted store is only ever opened at ordinary runtime, and — unlike the Tier-2 comptime effect gate — there is no `#Impure` escape hatch here.
 Fix: move the secret read out of comptime/module-field evaluation and into ordinary runtime code.
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E1265

Error [E1264]: `run` reads a secret but doesn't declare the `Secret` effect
  --> tests/ui/secret_in_build.jet:3:4
    |
  3 | fn run() {
    |    ^^^
 Why: reading a secret (`core.crypto.vault.get`) always requires an explicit grant — unlike other effects, there is no silently-inferred default here, so a function must opt in even with no other explicit effect row at all.
 Fix: add `=[Secret]=>` to `run`'s signature (or widen an existing effect row to cover it)
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E1264
